無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。 採用した計算法 Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。 L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。 Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic. Adopted numerical method Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering. Verification limits and failures This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
